Pick one with /; at least one base64 entry follows and can be chained indefinitely, generated with mihomo generate vless-x25519 and mihomo generate vless-mlkem768. Drop the parentheses when substituting values. Padding is optional and applies only in 1-RTT mode to mask handshake length. Both ends default to 100-111-1111.75-0-111.50-0-3333: after the 1-RTT client/server hello, append 111-1111 bytes of random padding with 100% probability, then wait 0-111 ms with 75% probability (probability-from-to), then send 0-3333 bytes of random padding with 50% probability (no Write() if length is 0). Server and client may set different padding parameters; chain them indefinitely in len, gap order; the first padding entry must have 100% probability and ≥35 bytes.
